h5: Order cancellation in case of unconventional pricing
p5: Low market depth in local markets may sometimes cause transaction prices in a market to be shown higher or lower than the actual price of cryptocurrencies. This happens because some users, due to their unfamiliarity with the market, place orders at the wrong price. Despite Artina's warnings during unconventional pricing, users repeatedly submit orders with incorrect prices. For this reason, the option to cancel transactions has been considered in Artina. Artina provides users the option to cancel orders before the auction ends. Users are required to be fully aware of the bid amount and the terms of the bid.
p6: Toman withdrawal requests from user accounts will be reviewed as soon as possible after submission. The time it takes to transfer money to users' accounts will vary based on interbank transfer limitations. For more information, refer to interbank transfer rules (Paya, Satna). The service fees and transaction costs for financial transactions carried out in Artina will be in accordance with the descriptions provided on the fees page.
p7: Artina consists of various functional components and capabilities, each of which is managed according to the rules and considerations communicated for them. For more information on these rules, refer to Artina's Telegram channel and the FAQ and support pages.
p8-1: To comply with anti-money laundering laws, all users are required to complete identity verification. The identity verification process is carried out in five steps by submitting the required documents:
p8-2: 1. Email Verification: After registering on Artina, a verification link will be sent to the registered email address. By confirming this link, the first step of identity verification will be completed.
p8-3: 2. Mobile Phone Number Verification: After entering your mobile number, a verification code will be sent to it. By entering the code into Artina, your mobile phone will be verified. Please ensure that the mobile number is correct, as it will be one of our communication methods with you in case of any issues. To upgrade to level 2, the mobile number must be registered in the user’s own name.
p8-4: 3. National ID Verification: In this step, you will upload a high-quality photo of your national ID, and your national number will be verified.
p8-5: 4. Bank Card Verification: At this stage, you will enter your bank card number. Ensure that the cardholder's name matches the uploaded national ID. After this step, you will be able to deposit funds into your Artina account.
p8-6: 5. Bank Account Verification: In this step, you will enter your bank account number. Ensure that the account holder's name matches the national ID provided. After this step, you will be able to withdraw funds from your Artina account.
p8-7: 6. Landline and Address Verification: To upgrade to level 2, providing a landline is mandatory. At this stage, Artina’s identity verification team will contact you via landline for verification.
p8-8: 7. Identity Picture Verification: To upgrade to level 2, you must provide a selfie according to the specified guidelines. For more information on user levels, required documents, and limitations at each level, refer to the profile page in Artina.
h9: Physical NFT Sales and Seller Responsibilities
p9-1: If you choose to mint an NFT that has a corresponding physical version (a tangible product), you agree to the following terms:
p9-2: 1. Seller’s Responsibility for Shipping: As the seller, you are fully responsible for the proper packaging, shipping, and delivery of the physical version of the NFT to the buyer. You must ensure that the physical item is delivered in good condition and within a reasonable timeframe agreed upon with the buyer.
p9-3: 2. Contact Information Sharing: Upon the successful sale of an NFT with a physical counterpart, your contact information (including name, email, phone number, and address, if necessary) will be shared with the buyer to facilitate communication regarding the delivery of the physical item. You agree that this information will be shared strictly for the purpose of ensuring the successful delivery of the physical product.
p9-4: 3. Costs and Liabilities: All costs associated with the shipment of the physical item (including packaging, shipping fees, insurance, and any applicable taxes or customs duties) are the seller’s responsibility unless otherwise agreed upon with the buyer. The platform is not responsible for any disputes arising from the delivery of physical items, including delays, damages, or non-delivery. Any issues should be resolved directly between the buyer and seller.
p9-5: 4. Compliance with Local Laws: As the seller, it is your responsibility to comply with all applicable shipping regulations, including customs, taxes, and any restrictions on the shipping of goods to the buyer's location. The platform does not assume responsibility for any legal or regulatory issues arising from the shipment of physical items.
p9-6: 5. Dispute Resolution: In the event of a dispute regarding the delivery of a physical item, both the buyer and seller are encouraged to communicate directly to resolve the matter. The platform may offer mediation, but it is not obligated to intervene or offer refunds or compensation.
p10: Artina is committed to protecting its users' personal information. Artina assures that users' assets will be safeguarded to the best of its ability and with the highest possible security standards.
